title: Feeling Off For No Reason?
caption: Feeling a bit snappy or fidgety today? A touch of extra space activity can make small things feel annoying, so take three slow breaths when you notice snappiness and move for two minutes to reset tension.
snapshot: Mostly quiet space conditions but with a little extra activity on the record. The slight southward field and a small CME add mild noise to the usual rhythm. That can raise restlessness for some people.
affects: You may feel short-tempered or oddly fidgety without a clear reason. Small tasks might feel more annoying than usual. For some, a little head pressure or tension will accompany the mood swings.
playbook:
- Take three slow breaths when you notice snappiness
- Move for two minutes to reset tension
- Step outside or get natural light
- Delay big talks if emotions feel sharp

fb.caption: Feeling snappy or oddly fidgety for no obvious reason? A little uptick in space activity can add mild mental static—small annoyances feel louder and tension shows up as head pressure or short temper. Why it matters: that background noise makes everyday tasks seem more irritating and conversations more likely to flare, so treat your reactions as signals, not personal failures. Practical pacing note: take three slow breaths when you notice snappiness, move for two minutes, and postpone big talks if emotions feel sharp.
